files.content:
<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/showcase.ts -->
<!--
  Two columns that set life without the product against life with it, point by point. Axes: layout (cards: two
  cards, rows: one row per point), icons (show, hide), tone, density.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Contrast, BeforeAfterLabels } from "./before-after.types";

  export type BeforeAfterProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    points: Contrast[];
    labels: BeforeAfterLabels;
    layout?: "cards" | "rows";
    icons?: "show" | "hide";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    density?: "default" | "compact";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Card from "../primitives/card/card.svelte";
  import CardContent from "../primitives/card/card-content.svelte";
  import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.svelte";
  import Group from "../primitives/group/group.svelte";
  import List from "../primitives/list/list.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../primitives/list/list-item.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import Title from "../primitives/title/title.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { cn } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    points,
    labels,
    layout = "cards",
    icons = "show",
    tone = "default",
    density = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: BeforeAfterProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame id={id} title={title} tone={tone} density={density} landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}>
  {#if ((layout as string) === "cards")}
    <Grid cols="1-2" class="items-stretch gap-4" data-testid="sides">
      <Card
        variant="muted"
        class={cn("h-full", (((density as string) === "compact") ? "gap-4 p-4" : ""))}
        data-testid="side"
        data-side="before"
      >
        <CardContent class="flex flex-col gap-4">
          <Title as={3} size="xl" weight="bold">
            {labels.before}
          </Title>
          <List class="m-0 flex list-none flex-col gap-4 p-0">
            {#each points as p (p.id)}
              <ListItem class="flex items-start gap-4" data-testid="item">
                {#if ((icons as string) === "show")}
                  <LucideIcon name="x" size={16} class="h-lh shrink-0 text-sm" />
                {/if}
                <Text size="sm">
                  {p.before}
                </Text>
              </ListItem>
            {/each}
          </List>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
      <Card
        variant="default"
        class={cn("h-full", (((density as string) === "compact") ? "gap-4 p-4" : ""))}
        data-testid="side"
        data-side="after"
      >
        <CardContent class="flex flex-col gap-4">
          <Title as={3} size="xl" weight="bold">
            {labels.after}
          </Title>
          <List class="m-0 flex list-none flex-col gap-4 p-0">
            {#each points as p (p.id)}
              <ListItem class="flex items-start gap-4" data-testid="item">
                {#if ((icons as string) === "show")}
                  <LucideIcon name="check" size={16} class="h-lh shrink-0 text-sm" />
                {/if}
                <Text size="sm">
                  {p.after}
                </Text>
              </ListItem>
            {/each}
          </List>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </Grid>
  {:else}
    <Stack gap="2" align="stretch" data-testid="rows">
      {#each points as p (p.id)}
        <Grid
          cols="1-3"
          class={cn("items-center gap-4", "rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-4")}
          data-testid="item"
        >
          <Text size="base" weight="semibold">
            {p.title}
          </Text>
          <Group gap="2" align="start">
            {#if ((icons as string) === "show")}
              <LucideIcon name="x" size={16} class="h-lh shrink-0 text-sm text-muted-foreground" />
            {/if}
            <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {p.before}
            </Text>
          </Group>
          <Group gap="2" align="start">
            {#if ((icons as string) === "show")}
              <LucideIcon name="check" size={16} class="h-lh shrink-0 text-sm text-primary" />
            {/if}
            <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
              {p.after}
            </Text>
          </Group>
        </Grid>
      {/each}
    </Stack>
  {/if}
</SectionFrame>
